components.title: Single local coordinator owner and replacement evidence sink
components.summary: Only the configured local AI owner starts coordinator client mode; polled replacement outcomes may be appended to a bounded private evidence sink.

components.title: Fence result consumer without peer evidence publication
components.summary: Fence results update or clear local active fence state and reset the pending request, while the indexed evidence append path is attached to polled replacement outcomes.

flows.title: Local owner result evidence and fence consumption

steps.description: Choose one configured coordinator owner AI, defaulting to AI ID zero.
Enable coordinator client mode only for that local owner and skip it for other local AI instances.
Read and correlate the pending fence result, update local active fence state, then consume the pending request.
Poll replacement outcomes and append correlated replacement evidence through the configured evidence sink.
Create an exclusive regular mode-0600 result file below an owned canonical mode-0700 root.

facts.statement: Coordinator client mode is owned by one configured local AI, default AI ID zero, and is skipped for other local AI instances.

Polled replacement outcomes are correlated with pending children and appended to the bounded private evidence sink; sink creation enforces a canonical owned mode-0700 root and an exclusive regular mode-0600 file.

The indexed fence branch consumes a correlated fence result into local active-fence fields and clears the pending request; the evidence-sink append shown in this module occurs in the separate replacement-outcome poll path.

The local owner producer can supply a correlated replacement result, but this source does not provide an independently emitted peer-B service result or fence record. Runtime peer agreement remains unknown.

open_questions: Which peer-local observer will publish fence and replacement service records on both actual simulation clients?
How will the root join each record to its producing process, synchronized interval and immutable packet without copying the owner producer result?
